life_insurance: Financial support for the people who depend on you if something happened to you.
term: Coverage for a defined period, generally designed to provide straightforward protection.
permanent: Coverage designed to remain in place longer, which may include features beyond the death benefit.
coverage_need: The total your family would need to stay on track: income, debts, mortgage, education and final expenses.
gap: Your coverage need minus what you already have in savings and existing coverage.
dime: A common way to estimate need: Debt, Income, Mortgage, Education.
